externalProductDependencies.reason: beads is the issue tracker underneath: it holds the work items, cooks and pours formulas, and owns every command dotdiw forwards. dotdiw adds discovery and hides the second name.
externalProductDependencies.boundarySemantics: A local subprocess on the same machine. dotdiw declines its hook installation and its Dolt remote, turns its usage metrics off before the first call, rewrites its name in everything it prints, and otherwise changes nothing it does. It has no POA IDL; the commands below are what dotdiw calls.
calledOperations: every command dotdiw does not own, forwarded unchanged

externalProductDependencies.reason: git is the registry and the sharing mechanism: a formula the project holds is one git tracks, and it reaches other people as every other file does.
externalProductDependencies.boundarySemantics: The project's own repository, read and never written: dotdiw lists tracked and untracked files, reads and unsets one config key that an earlier version let the tracker set, and diffs the files it edited. It never commits, pushes or syncs. It has no POA IDL; the commands below are what dotdiw calls.
